$comment: Scope map for this repository. Format: a JSON object whose 'scopes' array holds one entry per scope with 'id', 'name', 'owner' (an id from penguin/owners.json), 'paths' (path prefixes, relative to the repository root, that the scope owns), 'test_command' (a shell command run from the repository root; exit status 0 means the scope's tests pass) and 'depends_on' (one entry per provider scope: 'scope' is the provider's id and 'kind' is 'imports' when the consumer imports the provider's code).
